Contact

No contact form, no chatbot. If you have something genuine to say, email us at jack@thingshappening.comWe read every message and reply when it’s relevant to the site.Interested in working with us? See our sponsorship page.

What we’re open to.

  • Collaborations: Guest posts, cross-promotion, or working together on content about things to do in and around Chattanooga.
  • Corrections and feedback: Spotted a factual error, broken link, or have a genuine suggestion to improve a guide? Let us know.
  • Questions: Anything about events, places, or content covered on this site.

What we won’t reply to.

  • Marketing pitches, link exchange requests, or partnership spam
  • Requests for personalized travel planning or custom itineraries
  • Promotional content that doesn’t fit the site’s focus on local guides and events
